result.description: Global network platform for CDN, DNS, security, Zero Trust, and developer services (Workers, R2, etc.), managed via REST API.
result.auth_detail: Scoped API tokens (Account or User tokens, Bearer) are the recommended method; legacy Global API Key via X-Auth-Email/X-Auth-Key headers. Cloudflare's own MCP servers use OAuth, but no public OAuth app registration for third-party developers.
result.access_detail: Anyone can sign up for a free Cloudflare account and create API tokens in the dashboard. Some product endpoints require paid plans, but core API access is free.
result.api_notes: REST API covers 2,500+ endpoints across DNS, Workers, R2, Zero Trust and more; separate GraphQL Analytics API; OpenAPI schema available.
